title: Goofy Crazy TD
description: Place wacky cartoon turrets along winding lanes and unleash absurdly powerful combos to send waves of goofy invaders flying.
controls: Tap lane slots to deploy and upgrade quirky defense towers, merge firepower, and trigger special skills against incoming waves.

zh-CN.title: 憨憨疯狂塔防
zh-CN.description: 魔性搞笑卡通塔防：在弯道沿线排满脑洞炮塔与奇葩机关，花式升级打得蠢萌怪兽满天乱飞！
zh-CN.controls: 点击地图塔位建造并升级防御塔，合理组合火力与技能拦截全部怪物波次。
